IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Transportation (originally sponsored by Senators Kilmer and Sheldon)

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the extension of state route number 166;amending RCW 47.17.328; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It is the intent of the legislature that thestate route number 166 description be updated to reflect the currentcity limits of Port Orchard.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.17.328 and 1993 c 430 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A state highway to be known as state route number 166 isestablished as follows: Beginning at a junction with state route number 16 in the vicinitywest of Port Orchard, thence northeasterly to the eastern Port Orchardcity limits as they exist on the effective date of this act.
